name: ModNet Internet Services
summary: Dialup ISP + file archive + game servers (Modnet, ~1999); defunct.

events.details: Dialup, game servers. Operated by Mark Garland (Geraldton WA), per its own 1999 contact page.

Defunct. The by-Jul-2004 current value is wrong: the original ModNet ISP site was still being served in June 2019 and was replaced by a placeholder by Mar 2020. site live Jun 2019; placeholder by Mar 2020.

refs.label: 23 Jun 2019 still serving the original ModNet ISP portal
By 6 Mar 2020 the site was reduced to a one-line host placeholder
Own 1999 contact page names Mark Garland as management/proprietor; no company or ABN printed on 1999-2005 pages.
No ABR name matches the Geraldton ISP; directory listings (dlook/showmelocal/pinkpages) show 'Modnet Internet Services', Geraldton, (08) 9964 2722 but no entity
